summary: This note describes the Texas Army National Guard, a state-controlled military force of about 12,000 soldiers that maintains 117 armories across 102 communities. It lists the Guard's state duties, including disaster relief, emergency preparedness, security assistance to state law enforcement, and some border security. It also notes that the Governor can activate Guard components for state active duty in Texas and to support adjacent states.
one_line: Overview of the Texas Army National Guard's size, armory network, and state duties such as disaster relief and border security.
key_facts: The Texas Army National Guard is composed of approximately 12,000 soldiers.
The Texas Army National Guard maintains 117 armories in 102 communities.
State duties of the Texas Army National Guard include disaster relief.
State duties of the Texas Army National Guard include emergency preparedness.
State duties of the Texas Army National Guard include security assistance to state law enforcement agencies.
State duties of the Texas Army National Guard include some aspects of border security.
The Governor can activate the National Guard components under his control for state active duty in Texas.
The Governor can activate the National Guard components under his control in support of adjacent states.
